It is unclear exactly what led to today's surge. However, on Tuesday, the company posted updated data from its ongoing Phase 1/2 SOLARA trial of lead program, BH-30643, in EGFR-mutant non-small cell lung cancer.

Results showed that as of a May data cutoff, of the 40 patients with EGFR C797S-positive resistance to prior EGFR inhibitor treatment, with or without concurrent T790M, 16 achieved a confirmed possible response while another two had an unconfirmed response, leading to an objective response rate of 45%. The disease control rate was 88%. Median follow-up was 6.9 months.
